cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not the Real Fear
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on practical details so no one reaches the fear underneath them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we discuss me moving out, read the departure time back to me. The train time, please, not when we should leave the house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six twelve. Fifth time I've checked. Your ticket's in your hand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now the barrier: don't tell me the booking reference will open it. I need the actual code ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll walk you through. Are you frightened of leaving me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you need to check your own access. Please don't join the queue until we know whether you're allowed onto the platform without a ticket.

reason: Use A's procedural corrections to evade departure fear while B's escort solution causes the next specific practical objection.
